physics_goals.quote: The RENO experiment has observed the disappearance of reactor electron antineutrinos, consistent with neutrino oscillations, with a significance of 4.9 standard deviations.
physics_goals.value: Measure the neutrino mixing angle θ₁₃ via reactor antineutrino disappearance using near and far identical detectors

summary.plain: A South Korean experiment with two identical detectors near and far from a group of six nuclear reactors, which observed antineutrinos disappearing exactly as neutrino oscillation theory predicts. Data taking ran from 2011 to 2023.
summary.technical: Reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment at the Hanbit (Yonggwang) Nuclear Power Plant, Korea, with identical near (294 m) and far (1383 m) detectors from a 6 × 2.8 GW_th reactor array. Its 2012 result observed reactor antineutrino disappearance at 4.9σ, sin²(2θ₁₃)=0.113±0.013(stat)±0.019(syst). Data acquisition ran 2011-08 to 2023-03 (3800 live days); a final-dataset measurement (arXiv:2412.18711) reports sin²2θ₁₃=0.0920 and |Δm²_ee|=2.57 × 10⁻³ eV².
